# Norman Douglas

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty  <sub>[v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 c22 P20](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0020)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v5 c35 P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea / Glen St. Mary area  <sub>[v5 c9 P33](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0033), [v5 c15 P29](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0029), [v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v5 c16 P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027)</sub>

## Appearance

Norman is a big, fine-looking man with broad shoulders, a high white forehead, and a clear complexion. He has a sweeping, long red beard, a mane of thick red hair, and flashing blue eyes. Previously known for a vow that led him to grow his hair and beard extremely long, he later shaves his beard and trims his hair, revealing a strong, clean-shaven chin.

_Sources: [v5 c9 P13](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0013), [v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 c17 P28](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0028), [v5 c17 P35](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0035)_

## Personality

Norman is an outspoken, fiery, and headstrong man who is notorious for his fierce temper and loud, booming voice. Despite his blustering demeanor and stubbornness, he possesses a great deal of humor, a genuine liking for people with 'spunk,' and a deep secret generosity. He takes pleasure in sharp debates and intellectual jousting, enjoying sermons that stimulate his brain.

_Sources: [v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 c16 P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053), [v5 c16 P55](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0055), [v5 c16 P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079), [v5 c21 P2](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0002)_

## Traits

- Hot-tempered and boisterous  <sub>[v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 c21 P2](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Extremely stubborn and determined  <sub>[v5 c9 P35](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0035)</sub>
- Generous and kind-hearted under a rough exterior  <sub>[v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c16 P80](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0080), [v5 c26 P21](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0021)</sub>
- Politically passionate (Grit)  <sub>[v5 c9 P15](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0015), [v5 c15 P27](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0027)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled at physical work and farming  <sub>[v5 c16 P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027)</sub>
- Lively storyteller and jokester  <sub>[v5 c15 P2](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0002), [v5 c16 P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079)</sub>

## Goals

- To win the hand of Ellen West after decades of separation  <sub>[v5 c21 P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012), [v5 c35 P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)</sub>

## History

In his youth, Norman Douglas courted Ellen West, but following a sudden quarrel he impulsively married Hester Reese, whom he survived. After a disagreement with his church over the burial of a dog, he refused to attend services for twenty years. Fifteen years before the Liberal political victory, he vowed never to shave or cut his hair until the Grits returned to power, earning a reputation for his eccentric appearance. When the election results finally favoured his party, he immediately went to a local barber to have his hair and beard trimmed. Prompted by seeing Ellen West again, he renewed his courtship and eventually convinced her to break a long-standing maiden vow, culminating in their marriage.

_Sources: [v5 c9 P15](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0015), [v5 c9 P39](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0039), [v5 c15 P27](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0027), [v5 c15 P29](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0029), [v5 c17 P28](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0028), [v5 c21 P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012), [v5 c32 P12](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0012), [v5 c35 P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)_

## Background by volume

- A member of the prominent Douglas family of Four Winds  <sub>[v5 c15 P27](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0027)</sub>
- Courted Ellen West in his youth, but married Hester Reese after a quarrel  <sub>[v5 c15 P29](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0029)</sub>
- Took a political vow fifteen years prior to grow his hair and beard until the Liberals came into power  <sub>[v5 c9 P15](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0015)</sub>
- Stopped attending church for over twenty years after a dispute over his dog's burial  <sub>[v5 c9 P39](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0039), [v5 c15 P27](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0027)</sub>

## Quotes

> If you’d like some driftwood for your fire, Mistress Blythe, I’ll bring you up a load some day.  <sub>[v4 c6 P25](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0025)</sub>

> Come into your shop and do the best job you ever did in your life, Gus. The Liberals are in and you’re going to barber a good Grit before the sun rises.  <sub>[v5 c17 P29](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0029)</sub>

> What the dickens are you? And what do you want here?  <sub>[v5 c16 P30](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0030)</sub>

> I vow you’ve got spunk, after all—I like spunk. Come, sit down—sit down!  <sub>[v5 c16 P55](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0055)</sub>

> I’ll give an extra ten dollars every time you get your father to preach on hell.  <sub>[v5 c16 P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079)</sub>
